assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: opaque landscape anime MV frame, 1672 by 941.
Input images: Image 1 RALMIA identity reference, Image 2 LISHENNA identity reference. Image 3 is a three-panel STYLE board only. Image 4 is a three-panel WORLD reference board only; draw one coherent scene, no panels.
Create L12a: a quiet medium shot from behind and slightly above two fully clothed friends sitting side by side on a dark metal-framed cliff ledge overlooking the SAME warm flooded ruined white city as the world reference: broken white monumental arch, slender white spires and towers, water, and low setting sun ON THE RIGHT. Their legs dangle over the edge. Put the pair near the central foreground, about HALF of the total canvas height including dangling feet, leaving expansive city and sunset sky around them.
LISHENNA sits on the LEFT with her long coral-pink hair, black-and-white checkered band with two black rabbit-ear-like loops, two floating gold-rimmed black speaker discs with cyan sigils beside her head, off-shoulder white jacket and puffy sleeves, black high-waisted shorts, black thigh-highs and chunky white sneakers with purple laces. RALMIA sits on the RIGHT, long golden blonde hair and ahoge, white-and-black mechanical dress armor, cyan accent lights, black mechanical hands, white mechanical boots. Preserve their exact reference outfits.
LISHENNA rests her head against RALMIA's left shoulder. RALMIA gently tilts her head left toward LISHENNA. Rear view, no faces visible. If any RALMIA temple gem peeks out, only on the RIGHT side of her head in this rear view.
CRITICAL: clearly show their INNER hands resting on the bare rock ledge in the gap between them, one slender bare hand from LISHENNA and one black mechanical hand from RALMIA. Their LITTLE FINGERS hook together in a clearly readable pinky promise, all other fingers resting relaxed; keep this hand contact visible below and between their bodies and not hidden by hair or sleeves. No red thread anywhere.
Warm golden rim light from the right, calm affectionate wholesome mood, eye-level or slightly elevated camera, no kissing. Clean anime outlines, flat cel shading with only soft secondary shadows, slightly warm muted palette matching Image 3, crisp edges; no glossy neon painting. Single continuous image, no labels, no text, no watermark, no inset. Opaque background.
